svg.title: Build a small budget app
svg.desc: Illustrated night, 10:02 pm to 7 am By hand. 5 messages from you. 10:02 pm, Your message. “Build me a small app to track my budget” 10:11 pm, Your message. The app lists purchases. You explain that you want to see how much you have left to spend. 10:25 pm, Your message. You open it on your phone. The balance is off screen, so you ask to see it above the list. 10:36 pm, Your message. You ask the agent to enter a purchase and check that the balance drops by that amount. 10:48 pm, Your message. You ask it to check refunds too. Then you close the chat and go to bed. 11:05 pm, Agent. “Which database should I use for purchases?” The agent waits for you to choose one. 7:00 am, You return. You wake up to the database question. The build has been on hold for nearly eight hours. With 100x. 1 message from you. 10:02 pm, Your message. “Build me a small app to track my budget” 10:09 pm, Agent. The agent plans around one question. After a purchase, how much can you still spend? 10:48 pm, You go to bed. The agent keeps working. It chooses to save purchases on your device and records why. 11:50 pm, Agent. It enters a $4.35 purchase and refunds it. It checks that the original balance returns. 1:05 am, Second model. The reviewer opens the phone layout and spots that the balance sits below the purchase list. 2:15 am, Agent. The agent moves the balance above the list and saves a new phone screenshot in the report. 7:00 am, You return. You open the app, enter your first purchase, and see how much you have left to spend.
